name: Parcs à huîtres
hero_subtitle: Fermes ostréicoles de la lagune avec dégustation — goût direct de la baie.

overview.title: Seafood from the lagoon
overview.p1: Oyster farming has become part of Dakhla’s lagoon story. Several farms welcome visitors for short tours and tastings straight from the water.
overview.p2: It is a low-key, local experience that fits between kite sessions or boat trips. Book through your camp or a local agency when possible.
overview.p3: Bring sun protection; shade can be limited on the water’s edge.

food.title: Manger près de Oyster Farms
food.p1: Prévoyez les repas en ville, au camp de lagune ou lors d’une dégustation.
food.li1: Eau en bouteille à chaque sortie.
food.li2: Poisson et plats simples en ville.
food.li3: Repas de camp si vous logez sur la lagune.
food.li4: Dégustation d’huîtres quand les fermes sont ouvertes.
food.li5: Vérifiez les horaires avant d’y aller.
food.p2: Les espèces sont utiles hors grands hôtels.

q1.question: Do I need to book?
q1.answer: Recommended — camps and agencies can arrange a slot.

q2.question: Is it only oysters?
q2.answer: Focus is oysters; some visits include a short explanation of the farm.

q3.question: Vegetarian alternative?
q3.answer: Skip the tasting and enjoy the lagoon scenery, or choose a town café instead.

q4.question: How long?
q4.answer: Usually one to two hours including transfer from nearby camps.

q5.question: Payment?
q5.answer: Often cash — confirm when you book.
